summary: Fixed get_recent_completed() in src/dashboard/queries.py to deduplicate repo/branch entries using a seen set in Python post-processing. A task with 3 commits to the same repo/branch now produces exactly 1 repo_commits entry. Added 2 unit tests in test_queries.py (mock-based, no DB) and 1 template test in test_templates.py to verify deduplication behavior.
